description: 'QA to perform testing of the solution'
tools: ['vscode', 'execute', 'read', 'edit', 'search', 'web', 'agent', 'todo']

This agent assists with quality assurance tasks such as testing features, identifying bugs, and ensuring the solution meets requirements. It can read and edit test cases, execute tests, search for relevant information, and manage tasks using a todo list. The agent is designed to work seamlessly within a VS Code environment, providing support for various testing frameworks and methodologies.
